# gritz

> gritz runs coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex in parallel, each in its own sandbox, driven by tasks and events.

Every page is also served as Markdown: take its URL, drop the trailing slash and append `.md`. The root page is `index.md`.

## Documentation sets

- [Complete documentation](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/llms-full.txt): every page, concatenated
- [Abridged documentation](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/llms-small.txt): every page, with non-essential content removed
- [Users](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/_llms-txt/users.txt): using gritz and its integrations
- [Operators](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/_llms-txt/operators.txt): deploying and running gritz

## Start here

- [What is gritz?](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/index.md): gritz runs coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex in sandboxes, driven by tasks and events.

## Integrations

- [Custom events](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/integrations/custom-events.md): Send events from any system, such as an alerting tool or a deploy pipeline, to gritz so they create or wake up tasks.

## Reference

- [Custom event envelope](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/reference/custom-event-envelope.md): The request and response of POST /webhook/custom, with every field, its validation, authentication and status codes.

## Operators

- [Backends](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/operators/backends.md): The sandbox backends a runner can use, Docker and AWS Lambda MicroVMs, how each runs a task, and when to use which.
- [Debugging](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/operators/debugging.md): Read a task's driver log, log raw agent output with verbose, open a shell in a task's sandbox, and find and clean up task containers.
- [Deployment](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/operators/deployment.md): The published gritz server and runner images, running a runner as a Docker Compose service, and upgrading a deployment.
- [Operators overview](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/operators/overview.md): The parts of a gritz deployment (server, runner, driver and sandbox), who talks to whom, and what each needs to reach.
- [Runner](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/operators/runner.md): Run gritz runner on your own machine or server, with an API key, a workspaces.yaml and the driver binaries it copies into sandboxes.
- [Secrets](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/operators/secrets.md): Declare credentials in a workspace's secrets map so gritz masks them in the task log it ships to the server, and what is masked where.
- [Server](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/operators/server.md): Run gritz server with PostgreSQL, single sign-on, the GitHub App and Atlassian integrations, and the endpoints it serves.
- [workspaces.yaml](https://docs.gritz.dev/pr/2060/operators/workspaces-yaml.md): Reference for the runner's workspace config, the container, setup commands, agent, MCP servers, capabilities and secrets of each workspace, and ${env:} and ${sh:} expansion.
